caption: San Francisco peaks viewed from near Sunset Crater. Hung out there for a while trying to get good sunset and astro photos. Had no idea what I was doing. Read the manual, I guess.
Horsetooth in the summer. I like the colors.

Corona Arch out in Moab. Missed good lighting by a little bit, ended up here on a kind of aimless, meandering run. Big fan of this place, I feel like you could wander for days and keep finding cool things.
More from Moab. I feel like I've seen this picture a thousand times, like everyone who's ever been in Moab took this. Still neat.
This is on the way to McDonald's from Brendan's house. I always think pictures of murals will look cool and 95% of the time they don't. I hope Dogtopia isn't something offensive.
